products.name: Supernormal
products.note: Meeting notes AI; action items; CRM sync; team productivity data

profile_text.body:
Supernormal is a software company that offers an AI product designed primarily for agencies handling client work. The company describes itself as providing an AI agent that connects meetings, documents, and email context to produce client-facing deliverables such as emails, slides, visuals, docs, and insights.

The core product, also called Supernormal, falls in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and includes features for meeting notes, action item capture, CRM sync, and team productivity data. The company positions the tool as a way for agencies to turn meeting content into ready-to-use outputs quickly.

No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the available facts for Supernormal.
